messages:
incident-bot: [P1] PROD latency alert — p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~1.6s in us-west-2 inference service. Error rate for streaming requests up ~0.8%. Paging oncall. Incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/4378912345
elena: oncall here. acked. I'm collecting traces and perf. Priya, Jake — heads up.
jake: grabbing recent deploys. any kernel/infra changes in last 2 hours?
priya: FYI we pushed kernel v5.15.88-rc2 to canaries at 12:10 UTC and to ~40% of fleet at 12:40 UTC. rollout paused at 12:55.
jake: timeline: baseline p50~90ms, p95~120ms at 11:30. p95 jump starts ~12:45 coincident with kernel rollout. Grafana: https://grafana.company/shot/latency?panel=95
elena: mitigation: scaling inference-backend pool +2 nodes, enabling fallback-model small-quant variant for latency-sensitive routes. Doing now.
incident-bot: mitigation actions logged: scale_up(backend,2) by elena at 12:58; enable_fallback(model:quant-small) by elena at 12:59
priya: collecting perf counters (cpu_cycles, context-switches, sched_switch) across affected hosts. Starting `perf record` on one host:
```
# perf record -a -o /tmp/pulse.data -g sleep 60
```
jake: can you dump runqueue stats? `cat /proc/sched_debug | grep runqueue -A5` would help. Also need trace spans: set trace sampling to 100% for 5m on service.
elena: attaching short logs from node i-0abcd: `dmesg | tail -n 40` shows repeated rcu_preempt messages and "softirq backlog" warnings. snippet:
```
[12:46:21] rcu_preempt detected stalls
[12:46:22] INFO softirq: backlog=1120
```
luis: I'm taking handoff for mitigation. Plan: 1) pin affected hosts to old kernel 5.15.84 via reboot rollback (ETA 15m). 2) continue scaling. 3) gather flame graphs from perf. Assignments: elena->rollback, priya->perf traces, jake->trace spans + timeline.
customer-eng: customer impact: two enterprise customers reported streaming timeouts ~12:50-13:20 UTC, affecting ~3k requests total. Notifying accounts.
elena: rollback started on batch A (10 hosts). Rolling 5 at a time. Reboot cmd: `sudo apt install linux-image-5.15.84 && sudo reboot` (via safe-deploy).
jake: adding hypothesis tracker:
- H1: kernel scheduler change increases preempt latency -> p95 shift
- H2: regression in net driver under high concurrency -> softirq backlog
- H3: workload change + batching causing kv-cache misses
Collecting traces to validate.
incident-bot: note: timeline doc created https://redwood.incidents/4378912345/timeline by jake at 13:05
luis: update: after first 5 hosts rolled back p95 on those hosts reduced from ~1.5s -> ~180ms. Good signal. Continuing rollbacks; ETA full rollback 40m.
priya: uploaded perf flame: s3://redwood-traces/4378912345/host-i-0abcd/flame.svg
Observations: high percentage in softirq and scheduler wait; user-space stacks look normal.
jake: collecting aggregated tracing spans now. sample trace:
```
span: /generate -> db_fetch(3ms) -> model_infer(1300ms) -> send_stream
```
model_infer dominated on affected hosts.
elena: mitigation successful for rolled hosts. Keeping incident open to finish rollback and validate p50/p95 across regions. Will update timeline.
luis: handoff to night oncall @luis. Next: complete rollbacks, full perf collection, RCA writeup template.
incident-bot: incident status: mitigated for rolled hosts; severity downgraded to P2. Logged at 13:42"
